name: Export multi-domain AI citation snapshots to CSV with TriRank

parameters.content:
# Export multi-domain AI citation snapshots to CSV with TriRank

For SEO/GEO consultants and agencies: one manual run produces a downloadable inventory for 1-5 client or competitor domains. Unlike a change alert, it needs no Slack/SMTP credential, schedule or saved baseline.

**Setup:** Set bare domains in Configure domains. Run each domain through the [TriRank audit](https://trirankai.com/audit) once if you need a measurement; complete human verification yourself. Then Execute workflow and download the final node’s binary CSV.

**Boundary:** reads cached data from https://trirankai.com, never runs new AI probes. No fresh data is not zero citations. Different domains may have different prompts and measurement times: this is an inventory, not a fair ranking.

## 1. Configure and validate
One bare hostname per line, or comma/semicolon separated. URLs/paths/ports are rejected. www is normalized; duplicates use one read. Max 5 unique domains; too many fails before HTTP calls. Defaults are examples, not fabricated sample results.

## 2. Read-only API
One GET per domain, no retries. Anonymous limit: 60/day/IP, shared with other workflows. Optional x-api-key belongs in n8n Header Auth credentials, never exported JSON. 429 and network failures remain explicit rows.

## 3. Preserve unknowns
Only scored readings have a numeric score and all 4 verdicts. Partial means some checks are missing; other verdicts are not exposed. No data/errors leave score blank. Measurement time differs from lookup time. CSV never ranks domains.

## 4. Download CSV
Open Download citation CSV → Binary → Download. No external delivery or workflow activation required. You may connect storage later using your own credential; it is not configured by this export.
